node.description:
David is a street kid from Arroyo, Santo Domingo in Night City, who is enrolled into Arasaka's educational system at Arasaka Academy. He lives with his mother Gloria in an apartment of Megabuilding H4.

After experiencing a personal tragedy, David has the powerful Sandevistan speedware installed in his body and becomes one of Night City's edgerunners. He also becomes acquainted with [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/284157/Lucy), who leads him into the city's criminal underworld, and chooses to join the gang of edgerunners she is a part of, led by [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine).

Maine used to be a military soldier before he became a mercenary. Now a veteran edgerunner in Night City, Maine dreams of "making it big", although he values his friendships with his crew more than his own glory.

Raised in corpo towers but hardened in Maelstrom’s grip, Talia is fiercely independent and steeped in the gang’s hyper-violent, chrome-obsessed culture.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

A Snake Nation netrunner with sharp technical skills and a sharper hunger for revenge, D hunts the killer who wiped out his clan.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

name.native: ウィーク・キングスリー

node.description:
Once known as “King,” a veteran edgerunner at the top of his game, Weak now lives in the shadow of his former glory.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

Roman Carax is a young cinephile chasing real stories in a city that’s abandoned film for braindance. Obsessed with documenting truth, he shadows the lives of others — only to learn that unlike his favorite reels, Night City’s stories are messy, brutal, and rarely tied up with a clean ending.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

Project Capricorn, also known as simply Capricorn or Capri, is a personality construct created by [Kyoko](https://anilist.co/character/411116/%E3%82%AD%E3%83%A7%E3%82%A6%E3%82%B3) and the Arasaka Corporation, and is composed out of multiple, if not dozens, of digitized human psyches combined into one single psyche.

Capri was put onto an Arasaka biochip, that later would be stolen from the Arasaka Industrial Park by King's Crew. After Kingsley went cyberpsycho, and the rest of the crew went AWOL, the case containing the biochip was intercepted by Kyoko.

Jessie is a braindance engineer working at Sal Bigelow’s Braindance Paradise, tuning experiences for those looking to leave Night City behind, at least for a little while.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

A resident of Night City who seeks to destroy the Arasaka Corporation, which was responsible for her father's death. 

She is pragmatic enough to recognize D's potential and utilize it to achieve her goal.
Hideyoshi is a Japanese braindance director.

Once a jazz singer, corpo insider, and King’s old flame, Avida Yang left her old life behind. Now, her world revolves around one person: Talia.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

Avida’s husband and Talia’s father, Kiril is a composed Kang Tao executive whose smooth corporate calm masks a cold authority.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

__Birthplace:__ Westbrook, Night City
__Occupation:__ Associate Physical Security Specialist
__Employer:__ Arasaka Corporation
Owner of Braindance Paradise.

An Arasaka corpo, Kitano has built a life inside one of Night City’s most powerful corporations, where knowing who to trust can matter just as much as knowing who not to.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

A Kang Tao corpo, Richard is working for the weapons manufacturer that turned big moves into a place among some of the biggest corporate players.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.
Newly hired magical girl at Magilumiere who has an unusually good memory and a hard working personality. Her shyness made job hunting difficult until she was recruited by Magilumiere.
Magical girl employed by Magilumiere.
President and founder of the magical girl startup company Magilumiere. He is known for wearing cosplay in the office.

Engineer of magical technology employed by Magilumiere. He has extreme social anxiety, but an extreme love for magical girls as well which manifests in his concentration while working. He performs a vital support role from the office while the magical girls are in the field.

Magical girl employed at AST with the precision of a calculator. She stays composed in pursuit of efficient solutions and takes pride in being the company's ace. She is uninterested in things unrelated to her mission.
Magical girl employed by Miyakodo
Employee of Magilumiere who handles almost all the work involving social skills such as PR, HR, and customer relations single-handedly. He's always smiling and has an agreeable personality.
Magical girl initially employed by APDA.
Young girl who works as an engineer for Magilumiere's brooms

President of the magical girl company Ast, which prioritizes efficiency and utilitarianism in its work. He has a pattern of antagonism with President [Shigemoto](https://anilist.co/character/317445/Kouji-Shigemoto) of Magilumiere.
President of the magical girl company Miyakodo, who proposes a collaboration with Magilumiere due to her connection to President [Shigemoto.](https://anilist.co/character/317445/Kouji-Shigemoto)

Live-in assistant to [Ginji.](https://anilist.co/character/317450/Hana-Ginji) He was originally a government employed engineer but after being charmed by Ginji's skills, he quit to become Ginji's pupil.

node.description:
__Species:__ Werewolf

A quiet, reserved, and passive werewolf girl who aspires to become human because she wants to be more than just a half-baked existence.

__Species:__ Rabbit

A rabbit girl with a tendency to be a little harsh. Despite her sharp tongue, she's earnest at heart, and aims to become human in order to repay the kindness of those who once helped her.

__Species:__ Mozu

A cool, gyaru Mozu girl. She's caring and acts as a leader in her class. She says she wants to become human so she can play music.

__Species:__ Dragon

A noble dragon. Seeking to understand love, she aims to become human and relentlessly pursues [Hitoma](https://anilist.co/character/374176/Rei-Hitoma) whenever she finds an opening.

__Species:__ Black Cat

A girl who speaks little, steadfastly marching to her own beat, radiating an enigmatic aura even within the classroom. Her reason for wanting to become human remains a secret. She is often seen carrying books on black magic.

__Species:__ Mermaid

A mermaid lady with a very bright and cheerful personality. She aspires to become human so that she can dance, which she loves, with her own two feet. She is always positive and optimistic, and is the mood maker.

__Species:__ Oni

A descendant of the Oni with a carefree personality. She often cracks jokes or speaks offhandedly. Chose to become human because “She doesn't want to lie.”
Yuki is a science teacher.

__Species:__ Human

A man in his 30s who loves games. For some reason, he quit his job as a teacher and stayed at his parents' house for a while, distancing himself from people. By chance, he becomes a teacher at Shiranui High School, a school where non-humans aim to become humans.

__Species:__ Rat

A young rat girl who loves to eat delicious food. She dreams of becoming human and being able to eat even more delicious food. She's emotional, honest about her desires, and a playful person.
A fresh new teacher who has just arrived at the school year. Her charming smile and friendly personality make her a great choice.

__Race:__ Elf

An elf with a high sense of beauty who lived in the treetop city of Ryfgard. In order to show the world how beautiful she was, she decided to become human.
A math teacher who loves coffee. [Hitoma](https://anilist.co/character/374176/Rei-Hitoma)'s mentor.
The principal of Shiranui High School, characterized by his petite, round form and distinctive way of speaking.
